title: Manage the welcome message for a TikTok account
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps for managing the welcome message for a TikTok account using Business Messaging API. ## Introduction Welcome messages are the first interaction users have when they initiate contact with your TikTok account. They set the tone for your communication and help establish a positive user experience. With the Business Messaging API, you can create a new welcome message or modify the default one to suit your brand's voice. Each TikTok account can have one customized welcome message. **You can use Business Messaging API to greet users in a personalized and engaging way, fostering stronger connections and enhancing the overall user experience.** ## Prerequisites - You've gained access to TikTok API for Business. See [Get Started - Step by step workflow](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713609895937) for details. - To manage the welcome message for a TikTok account, you need relevant permissions. See [API Reference](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713875563521) to find out permissions required for endpoints (including the endpoints listed in the "Steps" section) and see [Update app permissions](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738855280338946) to find out how to configure permissions. - You have followed the steps in [Authorization](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184159540418) and [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184175482945) to obtain a TikTok account access token and the Application specific unique ID for the TikTok account. ## Steps To manage the welcome message for a TikTok account, follow these steps: ### Option 1: Create a new welcome message 1. **Set up a new welcome message** using [/business/message/auto_message/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184584869890). - Set `auto_message_type` to `WELCOME_MESSAGE` and specify the `welcome_message` object. 2. **Verify the status of the welcome message** using [/business/message/auto_message/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184619749377). - Set `auto_message_type` to `WELCOME_MESSAGE` and confirm that the `audit_status` of the message is `APPROVED` and `operation_status` is `ENABLE`.

Note: If `audit_status` of the welcome message is `REVIEWING`, you need to wait for some time before rechecking the review status. The exact waiting time may vary depending on the content and other factors, but normally ranges from a few seconds to 2-3 hours. 3. **Handle potential issues**. - If `audit_status` is `REJECTED`: 1. Update the welcome message using [/business/message/auto_message/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184596566017). 2. Recheck the status with [/business/message/auto_message/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184619749377). - If `operation_status` is `DISABLE`: - Enable the welcome message setting using [/business/message/auto_message/status/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184607786242) and set `operation_status` to `ENABLE`. ### Option 2: Modify the default welcome message 1. **Enable the default welcome message**. - Call [/business/message/auto_message/status/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184607786242) and set `operation_status` to `ENABLE`.

Note: If you enable the welcome message for a TikTok account for the first time, the default welcome message will be: `"Hi there,\nThanks for contacting {{display_name}}! Feel free to ask a question here or leave us a message and we'll get back to you shortly.\n\nThank you!"` 2. **Retrieve the default message** using [/business/message/auto_message/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184619749377). 3. **Update the message** using [/business/message/auto_message/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184596566017). 4. **Verify the status of the updated welcome message**. - Call `/business/message/auto_message/get/` again. Confirm that the `audit_status` of the updated message is `APPROVED` and `operation_status` is `ENABLE`.
